question_vi: Expo Modules API — khác biệt với TurboModule và khi nào dùng?
question_en: Expo Modules API — how does it differ from TurboModule and when to pick it?
answer_html_vi:
Expo Modules API là layer abstraction cao hơn TurboModule do Expo team viết. Cùng mục đích (gọi native từ JS) nhưng API gọn hơn nhiều, đặc biệt khi viết Swift/Kotlin idiomatic.

TurboModule (RN core):
- Spec TypeScript bắt buộc.
- Native code phải kế thừa class generated.
- Codegen step manual.
- Hỗ trợ Old + New Architecture.

Expo Modules:
- Định nghĩa module bằng DSL Swift/Kotlin:

swift
// ios/MyModule/MyModule.swift
import ExpoModulesCore

public class MyModule: Module {
  public func definition() -> ModuleDefinition {
    Name("MyModule")
    Function("greet") { (name: String) -> String in
      "Hello, \(name)!"
    }
    AsyncFunction("fetchData") { (url: String) async throws -> [String: Any] in
      // ...
    }
  }
}
kotlin
// android/src/main/java/expo/modules/mymodule/MyModule.kt
class MyModule : Module() {
  override fun definition() = ModuleDefinition {
    Name("MyModule")
    Function("greet") { name: String -> "Hello, $name!" }
  }
}

JS side đơn giản:

ts
import { requireNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core'
const MyModule = requireNativeModule('MyModule')
MyModule.greet('World')

Lợi điểm Expo Modules:
- Không cần spec TypeScript riêng (TS type inference từ DSL).
- Hỗ trợ event emitter, lifecycle, view component (cho Fabric) tích hợp sẵn.
- Unit test dễ hơn (mock DSL gọn).
- Expo team duy trì compat với RN versions.

Nhược:
- Phụ thuộc expo-modules-core ngay cả trong bare workflow (cần npx install-expo-modules).
- Ít control low-level so với TurboModule.

Khi nào chọn:
- Đang dùng Expo (managed hoặc bare): mặc định Expo Modules.
- Lib RN community thuần, không Expo: TurboModule.
- Performance siêu critical (audio DSP, ML): TurboModule + JSI custom (kiểm soát layer thấp hơn).
answer_html_en:
Expo Modules API is a higher-level abstraction layer over TurboModule built by the Expo team. Same purpose (call native from JS), but a far cleaner API — especially when writing idiomatic Swift/Kotlin.

TurboModule (RN core):
- TypeScript spec is mandatory.
- Native code must extend the generated class.
- Codegen step is manual.
- Supports both Old and New Architecture.

Expo Modules:
- Module definition is a Swift/Kotlin DSL:

swift
// ios/MyModule/MyModule.swift
import ExpoModulesCore

public class MyModule: Module {
  public func definition() -> ModuleDefinition {
    Name("MyModule")
    Function("greet") { (name: String) -> String in
      "Hello, \(name)!"
    }
    AsyncFunction("fetchData") { (url: String) async throws -> [String: Any] in
      // ...
    }
  }
}
kotlin
// android/src/main/java/expo/modules/mymodule/MyModule.kt
class MyModule : Module() {
  override fun definition() = ModuleDefinition {
    Name("MyModule")
    Function("greet") { name: String -> "Hello, $name!" }
  }
}

The JS side stays simple:

ts
import { requireNativeModule } from 'expo-modules-core'
const MyModule = requireNativeModule('MyModule')
MyModule.greet('World')

Expo Modules pros:
- No separate TypeScript spec (types are inferred from the DSL).
- Built-in support for event emitters, lifecycle, and Fabric view components.
- Easier to unit-test (the DSL mocks cleanly).
- The Expo team maintains compatibility with RN versions.

Cons:
- Depends on expo-modules-core even in bare workflow (run npx install-expo-modules).
- Less low-level control than raw TurboModule.

When to pick which:
- Already using Expo (managed or bare): default to Expo Modules.
- Pure RN community library, no Expo: TurboModule.
- Ultra performance-critical (audio DSP, ML): TurboModule + custom JSI (lowest layer of control).
